label: Late-episode D2 after switching from a1 to a2 and commonly reaching S2.
terms: (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * (ep_trial >= 80) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * (ep_trial >= 90) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * (ep_trial >= 80) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * (ep_trial >= 80) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * (prev_reward == 1) * (ep_trial >= 80) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * (ep_trial >= 70) * (ep_trial < 80) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 2) * (ep_trial >= 80) * belief_lo
explanation: Sparse feature (0.5% of steps), silent at D1 and GO. It fires only at D2 when the input shows a2 chosen and S2 reached (in_state + in_action == 4 picks out a2 -> S2 common), and only in the last ~20 trials of the episode, growing toward the end. The strongest driver is a switch: the previous trial chose a1 (weight ~0.38 vs ~0.07 for a repeated a2 after no reward). Among repeats of a2, it is larger when the previous trial(s) went unrewarded. The free fit adds the trial before being unrewarded, a weak positive belief_lo term, and a 70-79 band; it reaches dev 0.44 against 0.35 for the short form. Belief level itself adds little beyond the pattern. All terms use observed inputs only.
